actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined inflammatory/immune transcriptional identity with large effect sizes and very low q-values, supported by CNV alterations (VHL gain, chr14q/CDKN2A loss) with strong effect sizes. Technical confounders show no significant association, and known-label overlap is minimal. Although cross-modal silhouettes are weak, the biological evidence is strong and coherent, and no positive structural evidence supports Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0002 shows the complementary RNA profile (downregulation of inflammatory pathways) with equally large effect sizes and very low q-values, and CNV patterns opposite to C0001. Technical confounders are not significant, and known-label overlap is minimal. Despite weak cross-modal silhouettes, the biological identity is coherent and distinct from C0001, and no positive structural evidence supports Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 is better supported than Drop.
